root_cause: Customer Insights Journeys is partially installed at the solution/backend layer in JM1-Enterprise-Dev and JM1-Core, but not fully operationalized for authoring, sender/domain, consent topic, journey execution, or TEST validation.
observations: JM1-Enterprise-Dev and JM1-Core contain DynamicsMKT and msdyn_segment solutions.
JM1-Test does not contain the DynamicsMKT/Journeys footprint needed for TEST validation.
No Journeys records were found in the probed journey entity set.
No email channel/sender instances were found in the probed channel instance entity sets.
No topics or contact-point consent records were found.
Compliance settings and preference center records exist, but no JM1-specific lifecycle communication proof exists.
PAC application install exists, but application installation/provisioning is an admin tenant action and may surface licensing/capacity prompts.
safe_actions_completed_by_codex: Defined reusable journey contract and operating standard.
Prepared admin action packet and division handoff.
unsafe_or_blocked_actions: Creating internal Customer Insights Journeys sender/channel/journey records directly through Dataverse without supported canonical payloads.
Authenticating a sender domain or mailbox without Jackie/DNS/mailbox authority.
Installing Journeys into TEST if Microsoft presents a purchase/capacity prompt.
Sending a production communication before sender/domain, compliance, and suppression behavior are configured and proven.
